defeat: Corrin dies* or the player's army is routed*
vein: "Slows fliers, speeds others. But Hinoka...". They are located as follows: Column 7, row 21: Two spaces west of a Tiger Spirit/Steel Club Oni Chieftain Column 13, row 17: Three squares west, three squares south of a Tiger Spirit Onmyoji (Normal/Hard only) Column 12, row 15: Four squares west, one square south of the same on Onmyoji, just within Azama's Hexing Rod range (Lunatic only) Column 19, row 16: Three squares east, two squares south of the aforementioned Tiger Spirit Onmyoji Column 14, row 4: Three squares south, two squares east of Hinoka's position (Normal only) Column 12, row 1: Hinoka's position. This vein has the reverse effect of the others (speeds fliers, slows others); Hinoka activates it whenever no other Dragon Vein is currently in effect. Column 10, row 4: Three squares south, two squares west of Hinoka's position Column 9, row 10: One square south, one square east of a Rabbit Spirit Onmyoji (Normal only) The Dragon Veins grant/inflict a Movement bonus/penalty equal to half of the class's base movement, rounded down; it does not factor in boosts from Boots, skills or the like. The effect lasts for two turns before wearing off.
